AMENDMENT 
 
 to the Investment Facility Agreement dated 14 September 2023 (“ Investment Facility Agreement”), by and between 
 
 Dubizzle Labs ( SMC- Private) Limited (“ Investor ”) and Daftarkhwan (Private) Limited (“ Investee ”) 
 
 [Each a “ Party ” and, collectively, “ Parties ”] 
 
 This Amendment (“ Amendment ”) to the Investment Facility Agreement , is made and entered into at Lahore on this _______________________ (“ Execution Date ”), by and between the Parties. 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows: 
 
 The Amendment shall be effective from the Execution Date. 
 
 Clause 4.2 of the Investment Facility Agreement is hereby amended and restated in its entirety to read as follows: 
 
 “ The Profit will be payable at the rate of 1-month KIBOR plus 2% per annum, commencing from the seventh (7 th ) month of the Effective Date.” 
 
 This Amendment shall be read as an integral part of the Investment Facility Agreement. 
 
 All other terms and provisions in the Investment Facility Agreement shall apply mutatis mutandis and shall continue in full force and effect in accordance with the terms mentioned therein. In the event of any conflict, the provisions of this Amendment shall prevail and any conflicting term in the Investment Facility Agreement shall be deemed amended appropriately. 
 
 All expressions and terms defined or used in the Investment Facility Agreement shall bear the same meaning in this Amendment, unless otherwise specified.
